# ControlP5 2.2.6

Copyright 2006–2015 Andreas Schlegel. Licensed under the [GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later](LICENSE.md).

The unmodified runtime library is bundled at `../../code/controlP5.jar`. Processing loads it from the sketch's `code/` folder and includes it when exporting an application. It can be replaced independently of Pixy's source.

- [Official release](https://github.com/sojamo/controlp5/releases/tag/v2.2.6)
- [Included source and build resources](controlP5-2.2.6-source.zip), from the [upstream v2.2.6 tag](https://github.com/sojamo/controlp5/tree/v2.2.6). The release sources match this tag after substituting the release date and version placeholders.
